messages:
Nina L: Heads-up: starter-kit tests flaking on structured tool-calls after transient auth failures. Root cause looks like the TS SDK 'retry' path double-wraps already-serialized json-mode bodies -> server schema rejects due to quote-encoded payload + trailing delimiter.
Devon R: Can you show a minimal repro?
Nina L: Repro: call a function-tool with json-mode helper (adds '\n' delimiter). First request gets 401. Retry wrapper runs and does JSON.stringify(body) again. Server receives '"{...\n}"' (a quoted string with escaped newline) so strict schema parse fails. Also signing bytes differ from Py which signs raw bytes with newline.
Isha T: Interesting — two fixes: prevent re-serialization in retry, and unify canonical signing byte sequence across SDKs (include newline if helper added it).
Devon R: Agreed. Additional edge: when multiple tools present, helper sometimes coerces payload into an array; double-wrapping then becomes an array-of-quoted-strings which validator rejects. Add unit test for payload shape.
Nina L: Action items: (1) Isha will patch retry middleware to detect Buffer/string and send as-is; (2) Devon will add signature-parity unit tests against the Py helper; (3) I'll add an e2e sample that stubs auth to 401 once then 200 and asserts Buffer equality of the received body.
Isha T: Patch incoming tonight. Quick snippet: const payload = typeof opts.body === 'string' || Buffer.isBuffer(opts.body) ? opts.body : JSON.stringify(opts.body); sign(Buffer.from(payload)); send(payload);
Devon R: Also add a migration note to SDK guide: "If using json-mode serialization, middleware must not re-serialize; preserve raw bytes for signing and schema parity."
ci-bot: PR #4912 opened by isha-t: "ts: avoid double-serialize in retry; sign canonical payload" — https://ci.redwood/p/4912
Nina L: Once PR lands, run sample-kit CI and watch for flaky failures. Thanks team :sparkles:
